Of all the tickets printed for "100X Merry MONEY", about three-quarters are still unsold. The game is still new, with three of three top prizes unclaimed. In every scratcher, either the tickets or the prizes run out first. The rest of this page shows the details.

Today's free summary of "100X Merry MONEY" ends here. Every number behind it is on this page.
1918.headline: Early stage or late

1921.body:
"$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" is in the middle of its run, with about two-thirds of its tickets still unsold. Late in a run, a game is worth a look when prizes outlast tickets. Early on, the prize design matters most. Here, a larger share of the top prizes is left than of the tickets, which is a good sign.

If you play "$500,000 HOLLYWOOD RICHES" often, bookmark this page. The write-up is updated with each morning's data.
